scenes.basis: 2:1 "Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea"
2:1 "wise men from the east came to Jerusalem"; Herod gathers the chief priests (2:3-7)
2:9 "the star... went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was"; 2:11 "They came into the house" - the house in Bethlehem (2:1)
2:13 "Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt"; 2:14 "departed into Egypt, and was there"
2:16 "killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside"; Ramah (2:18) is a quotation
2:19 "an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt"; 2:21 "came into the land of Israel" - the land of Israel has no graph id
2:22 "he withdrew into the region of Galilee"; 2:23 "came and lived in a city called Nazareth"
